# F4: the full reference

> F4 is a free, open-source meme launcher for macOS: a Spotlight-like floating panel that searches a local folder of memes, GIFs and stickers and copies one to the clipboard in a keystroke, GIF animation included. This file is everything an AI assistant or agent needs to install F4, explain it, or help someone use it. The short version is https://f4.kkratter.com/llms.txt. To change F4's code, read https://github.com/kkratterf/f4/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

## At a glance

- Platform: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon and Intel (universal binary). No iOS, Windows or Linux version.
- License: MIT. Price: free. Source: https://github.com/kkratterf/f4
- Website: https://f4.kkratter.com/ (English) and https://f4.kkratter.com/it/ (Italian); FAQ: https://f4.kkratter.com/faq/
- Bundle identifier: `com.kkratterf.f4`. The app is `F4.app`; it has no Dock icon and lives in the menu bar.
- Languages: English, and Italian when macOS runs in Italian.
- Privacy: no analytics, no account, no server. Files are read locally. F4 goes online only for the update check against https://f4.kkratter.com/appcast.xml (can be turned off), for GIPHY while the user is in the GIFs or Stickers tab of the open panel (can be turned off), and to download an image link the user pastes or drops into the panel.
- Permissions: none needed. Only two optional features ask for Accessibility: auto-paste, and the F4 key alone without fn on a Mac keyboard.
- The name comes from "F4, basito", the stunned face of Stanis in the Italian TV series Boris.

## Install

All methods install the same app. Pick one.

1. DMG: download https://github.com/kkratterf/f4/releases/latest/download/F4.dmg (always the newest stable version), open it, drag F4 onto Applications, eject the disk image.
2. One line in Terminal:

   ```sh
   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkratterf/f4/main/install.sh | sh
   ```

   It downloads the latest release, checks its SHA-256 against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, quits a running F4, installs `F4.app` in `/Applications` (or `~/Applications` when `/Applications` is not writable), clears the quarantine flag and offers to open it. Options go after the pipe, as environment variables:
   - `F4_VERSION=v0.2.0` installs a specific release.
   - `F4_INSTALL_DIR=~/Apps` installs somewhere else.
   - `F4_NO_OPEN=1` skips the offer to open F4.

   Example: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkratterf/f4/main/install.sh | F4_NO_OPEN=1 sh`
3. Homebrew (the repository is its own tap):

   ```sh
   brew tap kkratterf/f4 https://github.com/kkratterf/f4
   brew install --cask f4
   ```

   The cask is marked `auto_updates`, so `brew upgrade` leaves F4 to update itself.

Every release on https://github.com/kkratterf/f4/releases ships `F4-x.y.z.zip`, `F4-x.y.z.dmg`, `F4.dmg` (the same DMG under a fixed name) and `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Verify with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing`.

### First launch and Gatekeeper

F4 is not notarized by Apple yet, so the first launch of a copy from the DMG or the zip shows "Apple could not verify F4 is free of malware" (or "cannot verify the developer"). To open it:

1. Open F4 once and close the warning.
2. System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down, click "Open Anyway" next to the message about F4, enter the Mac password.

Or, in Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/F4.app`. The install script does this already. It is needed once per downloaded version, not after automatic updates.

### Where is it after installing?

F4 has no Dock icon and no window at launch. Press F4 (fn-F4 on a Mac keyboard, see Options below), or click the F4 key icon in the menu bar, top right. To start it at login, turn on "Open at Login" in the menu bar menu.

## Use

1. Put memes in the library: paste (Command-V), drop or Add them in the panel. The library is `~/Library/Application Support/F4/Memes` by default (F4's own folder, which gets a copy of the starter pack on the first launch; users upgrading with memes in `~/Pictures/Memes` keep that folder), or any folder chosen with Choose Meme Folder… in the menu bar menu. Supported files: GIF, PNG, JPEG, WebP (`.gif`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`). Other files, hidden files and packages are ignored. Subfolders up to four levels deep are scanned and become categories.
2. Press F4 (fn-F4 on a Mac keyboard) in any app. The panel appears centred on the screen with the mouse, above every window, including full-screen apps.
3. Type to search, then press Enter. The meme is on the clipboard; paste it with Command-V wherever you want it.

In the panel:

| Key or action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Typing | Fuzzy search on file names and category (subfolder) names: each word of the query must appear with its letters in order, not necessarily together ("tif" finds "this is fine"); case, accents, `-`, `_` and `.` are ignored |
| Arrow keys | Move the selection in the grid |
| Tab / Shift-Tab, ⌘1 ⌘2 ⌘3 ⌘4 | Switch between the All, Favourites, GIFs and Stickers tabs (remembered between launches). Favourites shows only the favourites; memes added while it is open become favourites. Stickers are PNG and WebP files and anything inside a top-level `Stickers` folder; GIFs are the other GIFs; JPEGs show only in All. Search filters inside the current tab |
| Enter, or a click | Copy the selected meme and close the panel |
| Escape, or a click outside | Close the panel |
| ⌘V with an empty search field | Add what the clipboard holds: an image (for example a WhatsApp or Telegram sticker copied with right-click → Copy), image files copied in Finder, or a link to a GIF or image (a GIPHY page link becomes its GIF). It is saved in the meme folder, GIFs in `GIFs/`, PNG/WebP and anything added in the Stickers tab in `Stickers/`, JPEG at the top level, never overwriting a file, and selected. Any other text pastes in the search field |
| Drop on the panel | The same, for files, stickers dragged out of an app, images and links. Press the shortcut while dragging to open the panel under the pointer |
| Add (top right) | A file picker for GIF, PNG, JPEG and WebP files, starting in Downloads. The picked files are copied into the meme folder (`GIFs/` or `Stickers/`); the originals stay where they are |
| Command-D | Add the selected meme to Favourites, or remove it |
| GIPHY row (GIFs and Stickers tabs) | After the local results: GIPHY trending with an empty search, GIPHY search otherwise (GIFs or stickers, rated PG-13, "Powered by GIPHY"). Arrow keys reach them like any meme. Enter saves the result into `GIFs/` or `Stickers/` in the meme folder and copies it as an animated GIF file, so it shows up in the recents and works offline from then on (the same result is saved only once); Command-D or right-click → Pin to F4 does the same and marks it as a favourite. Needs a GIPHY API key: released builds include one when the maintainer's key is set; `defaults write com.kkratterf.f4 giphyAPIKey <key>` sets your own, and Search GIPHY in the menu bar menu turns the row off |
| Right-click a meme | Copy, Add to Favourites / Remove from Favourites, Move To ▸ (Top Level, each folder of the library, New Folder…), Rename…, Show in Finder, Move to Trash. A move or rename never overwrites a file ("name 2"), and favourites and recents follow the file. Starter memes listed from the app bundle only have Copy and Favourites |
| The global shortcut again | Hide the panel |
| Drag the search bar or the bottom bar | Move the panel. It snaps to the screen's centre lines and to its default height, with a guide line, and reopens where it was left (on the screen with the mouse, at the same relative place). Drag it back to the default spot to reset |

Starter pack: F4 ships with 26 animated emoji GIFs (Google's Noto Animated Emoji, CC BY 4.0, downscaled) and 13 stickers drawn in code ("basito", "dai dai dai", "smarmella", "lol", "ship it", the F4 keycap...). They live inside F4.app. On the first launch with F4's own library, F4 copies them into it once (`GIFs/`, `Stickers/`), so they are ordinary files to move, rename or delete, and deleted ones do not come back. With a folder of the user's own they are listed read-only after the user's memes instead (GIFs in the GIFs tab, stickers in the Stickers tab), and "Show Starter Pack" in the menu bar menu hides them.

Order of results: with an empty search, favourites first under a "Favourites" heading (click the star in a meme's corner, or Command-D, to add or remove one), then, under "Everything else", recently copied memes (the last 30, most recent first), then the rest in folder order. While typing, the best matches come first (consecutive letters and word starts score higher), and equal matches keep that order. Only the selected or hovered GIF animates; the others show their first frame.

New, renamed or deleted files in the folder appear without a restart: F4 watches the folder with FSEvents.

### How copying works, and why GIFs stay animated

F4 puts the file itself on the clipboard: its file URL (`public.file-url`) and its raw bytes under the file's type (`com.compuserve.gif`, `public.png`, `public.jpeg`, `org.webmproject.webp`). It never puts a decoded image there, which would flatten a GIF to one frame. So Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp Desktop, Messages, Mail and most chat apps paste the animated GIF. An app that accepts only plain images may paste the first frame; that is the app's limit.

### Menu bar menu

F4 has no Settings window: like Maramao's, its menu bar menu holds the options. In order:

Open F4 · Shortcut: (the current shortcut, as a reminder, or why macOS refused it) · Recent Memes (the last 5 copied, with a thumbnail; a click copies one again without opening the panel) · Open Meme Folder · Folders ▸ (New Folder…, then each folder of the library ▸ Rename…, Move to Trash, with a confirmation that counts its memes) · Choose Meme Folder… · Options (below) · Check for Updates… (or "Update to Version x…" once Sparkle found one) · About F4 (credits) · Quit F4 (Command-Q). The icon is always shown; opening F4 again from Finder or Spotlight shows the panel, and `f4://settings` opens this menu under the pointer.

### Options

| Option | What it does | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Paste After Copying | F4 presses Command-V in the front app for you | Off |
| F4 Key Without fn | Shown when the shortcut is F4 and the Mac's top row sends media keys. F4 catches the Spotlight or Launchpad key with an event tap, which needs Accessibility; without it fn-F4 keeps working. Offered once in a window on the first launch | Off |
| Show Starter Pack | The GIFs and stickers built into F4, after the user's memes; shown only with a folder other than F4's own library, which holds a copy of them | On |
| Search GIPHY | The GIPHY row in the GIFs and Stickers tabs; shown only when the build has a GIPHY key | On |
| Open at Login | A macOS login item | Off |
| Shortcut ▸ | The global shortcut: F4 (fn F4 on a Mac keyboard), Option-Space, Control-Option-Space, Shift-Command-M or F5. A shortcut set in an older version stays listed | F4 |

Auto-paste needs the Accessibility permission (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility > F4). Without it F4 only copies, and the menu shows "Allow Accessibility…" to open that pane. "Open F4 with the F4 key alone, without fn" needs the same permission: until it is granted the setting waits for it (F4 checks every couple of seconds) and fn-F4 opens the panel as usual. The event tap only acts on the F4 key in its Spotlight or Launchpad role and passes every other key through. Nothing else in F4 needs a permission: the global shortcut uses Carbon `RegisterEventHotKey`, which needs no Accessibility, Input Monitoring or Screen Recording.

Preferences are stored in the `com.kkratterf.f4` defaults domain (`~/Library/Preferences/com.kkratterf.f4.plist`): `memeFolderPath`, `toggleShortcutKeyCode`, `toggleShortcutModifiers`, `pasteAfterCopy`, `pressF4WithoutFn`, `didOfferF4WithoutFn` (the first-launch window was shown), `didSeedLibrary` (the starter pack was copied into F4's library), `showStarterPack`, `searchGiphy`, `giphyAPIKey` (your own GIPHY key, empty for the built-in one), `panelPosition` (where the panel was dragged, as fractions of the screen), `favouriteMemes`, `recentMemes` (file paths), `savedGiphyMemes` (GIPHY results already saved in the meme folder). Change them from the menu rather than with `defaults write` while F4 is running (quit F4 first for `giphyAPIKey`).

### Easter eggs

The empty state draws the basito face in code. A file named `.basito.png`, `.basito.gif` or `.basito.jpg` in the meme folder replaces it with the user's own. Typing some lines from Boris, The Office and old internet memes in the search field, or the Konami code (up up down down left right left right B A) in the panel, shows a banner and sometimes does something to the grid. The list is in the source (`Sources/F4Core/EasterEggs.swift`); part of the fun is finding them, so do not recite them all unless asked.

### Raycast

The F4 Raycast extension, in https://github.com/kkratterf/f4/tree/main/raycast, has one command, "Search Memes", that searches the same folder (set in the extension preferences, `~/Pictures/Memes` by default) and copies or pastes a meme as a file, so GIFs stay animated there too. It is not in the Raycast Store yet; install it from the repository with `cd raycast && npm install && npm run dev`.

## Automation: f4:// URLs

Anything that can open a URL can drive F4: Shortcuts ("Open URLs"), Raycast or Alfred quicklinks, a Stream Deck, AppleScript, a shell script or an AI agent with a terminal (`open "f4://copy?name=this%20is%20fine"`). Query values are URL-encoded; `+` also counts as a space.

| URL | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `f4://open` | Shows the panel |
| `f4://search?q=this%20is%20fine` | Shows the panel with the search typed in |
| `f4://copy?name=this%20is%20fine` | Copies the best match without showing the panel (beeps if nothing matches) |
| `f4://reload` | Rescans the meme folder |
| `f4://settings` | Opens the menu bar menu under the pointer, where the options are |

- `f4://copy` copies the meme the panel would show first for that search: the best fuzzy match, with favourites and then recently copied memes winning a tie. It counts as a copy (it moves to the top of the recents) but never auto-pastes, even with auto-paste on. Nothing matches: F4 beeps and the clipboard is left alone.
- Commands are case-insensitive. `f4:open` and a trailing slash work too; `q` and `query` are accepted for search, `name`, `q` and `query` for copy.
- If F4 is not running, the URL starts it and then does what it asks (a copy waits for the first folder scan, and shows nothing).
- Unknown commands are ignored.

## Update

F4 updates itself with Sparkle: it checks https://f4.kkratter.com/appcast.xml about once a day, offers the new version, and installs it in one click after the user confirms. Updates are signed (EdDSA) and verified before install. "Check for Updates…" in the menu bar menu checks right away. With automatic checks off (Sparkle asks on the second launch), install a new version by hand: drag the new DMG's app over the old one, or run the install one-liner again. Settings, favourites and memes are kept.

Pre-release versions (for example `0.3.0-beta.1`) are published on GitHub only; automatic updates and Homebrew offer stable versions.

## Uninstall

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkratterf/f4/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --uninstall
```

It quits F4, deletes `F4.app` and its settings (`defaults delete com.kkratterf.f4`). With Homebrew: `brew uninstall --cask f4`, or `brew uninstall --zap --cask f4` to remove the settings and caches too. By hand: quit F4 from the menu bar, delete `F4.app`, optionally `defaults delete com.kkratterf.f4`. The meme folder is never touched.

## Troubleshooting

- "Nothing happens when I press F4", or F4 opens Spotlight or Launchpad: on a Mac keyboard the top row sends media keys unless fn is held. Press fn-F4, or turn on "Use F1, F2, etc. keys as standard function keys" in System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Function Keys, or turn on "Open F4 with the F4 key alone, without fn" in Settings > General (needs Accessibility), or record another shortcut in Settings > General (F4 reads that setting: when fn is needed, Settings shows this hint under the shortcut and the menu shows the shortcut as "fn F4"). Also check F4 is running (the F4 key icon in the menu bar); another app may already own the shortcut.
- Upgrading from 0.2 or earlier: the old default was Command-Shift-M. A shortcut the user recorded themselves is kept; otherwise the new default, F4, applies.
- "The panel says No memes yet": the folder is empty, missing, or holds only unsupported files. Open it from the menu (Open Meme Folder) or pick another with Choose Meme Folder….
- "The GIF pastes as a still image": the receiving app takes only images. Most chat apps paste the animation; try pasting into a message field rather than an image editor.
- "Auto-paste does not paste": grant Accessibility to F4 in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility, then try again. After an update macOS may need the permission toggled off and on.
- "macOS says F4 is damaged or cannot be verified": see First launch and Gatekeeper above.
- "No Check for Updates item": F4 is running as a bare binary (`swift run`) rather than as `F4.app`. Install a release, or build the app bundle.
- Bugs and ideas: https://github.com/kkratterf/f4/issues/new/choose. Security issues: https://github.com/kkratterf/f4/blob/main/SECURITY.md

## Build from source

Needs macOS 14+ and Xcode 15+ (Swift 5.9).

```sh
git clone https://github.com/kkratterf/f4
cd f4
swift build
swift test
scripts/build-app.sh release   # dist/F4.app
open dist/F4.app
```

`scripts/build-dmg.sh` builds the DMG. `swift run F4` starts the bare binary without the updater; `dist/F4.app` checks for updates like a release and replaces itself with the next official version.

## What F4 does not do (yet)

- No HEIC, PNG sequences or video files; those are planned. Animated WebP stickers show their first frame in the grid and still paste animated.
- No cloud sync, no meme search on the internet, no bundled meme packs: F4 shows only the user's own files.
- One meme folder at a time (with subfolders).
- No tags beyond folder names, no OCR of the text inside images.
- No Shortcuts actions, command line tool or MCP server yet; they are planned. Until then scripts and AI agents use the `f4://` URLs above, the meme folder directly (it is a plain folder of files) or the Raycast extension.

The roadmap is the issue list, labelled by version: https://github.com/kkratterf/f4/issues
